items: 【Natural Acacia Wood】Patio furniture is made of whole solid Acacia wood, which provides better load bearing and appearance than traditional synthetic wood. Beside, the surface has been lightly polished and varnished to make it feel smoother.

【Padded Soft Cushions】Porch furniture cushion is filled with soft foam and the exterior is made of high quality fabric, which provides better comfort. Come with banding rope, cushions can be fixed in the back and will not move around. Also designed with zipper, easy to replacement and maintain.

【Thoughtful Design】The seat and back of the outdoor furniture are designed with spaced gaps to ensure stability while providing better breathability, it can remain cool even in hot summer. Outdoor chairs back are designed with a 110°angle, which could provide better support and comfort.

【Wide Application】The natural wood look and minimalist design make this patio set easy to integrate into your indoor and outdoor living scenarios, such as balcony, front porch, poolside, lawn, backyard. A good choice for your outdoor decoration.

【Please Note】Please do not scratch the surface with hard objects, and we recommend storing the balcony furniture when rains to prevent wood corrosion. If you have any problems about the product before and after buy, please feel free to contact us.
